tax.text: Russell pledges to cut taxes and defend Proposition 13 taxpayer protections.
tax.quote: We pay some of the highest gas and income taxes in the nation. As your Assemblyman, I will fight to cut taxes and defend the taxpayer protections of Prop 13.

safety.text: Russell supports providing police officers with additional resources and institutional backing.
safety.quote: Support for Peace Officers: Providing the resources and backing our officers need to keep us safe.

sentencing.text: Russell calls for stronger penalties and tougher consequences for repeat offenders.
sentencing.quote: Stronger Penalties: Ensuring repeat offenders face tougher consequences.

immigration.text: Russell supports a secure, merit-based immigration system that prioritizes citizens and legal residents while offering vetted legal pathways.
immigration.quote: On immigration, he supports a secure, merit-based system: protect citizens first, uphold legal residents who contribute and assimilate, and offer a compassionate, vetted path for those truly seeking the American dream.
